text: People born without a working C5 protein | get meningococcal infections, again and again.
Eculizumab is a drug that blocks C5.
Its label opens with a boxed warning: | *serious meningococcal infections*.
The disease predicted the side effect.
Knockout turns that into a method.
A drug that blocks a protein is a *chemical knockout*. | It should cause a milder form of that protein's disease.
Ask it in plain words: | what side effects should a C5 blocker cause?
The Fetch.ai orchestrator finds five approved C5 blockers | and picks eculizumab.
The target agent reads what the drug acts on, | and which way, from ChEMBL.
The genetics agent finds the disease where C5 fails the same way, | and its symptoms.
The label and report agents check each symptom | against the FDA's records.
Today those two answer unknown: | mapping symptoms to report terms needs a Gemini key. | They say which step failed, and never call unknown safe.
The report page shows the same chain from the live API, | down to three predicted effects.
They're not checked yet, | so we checked the meningococcal one by hand with the engine's code, | and show it in the page's fixture.
The boxed warning matches word for word. | 86 of 54,046 eculizumab reports name the infection, | against 311 in 20.7 million.
A proportional reporting ratio of *146*.
One example proves nothing, | so the measurement was fixed before any scoring.
A script picks the drugs: 52 approved drugs | whose target has a genetic disease pointing the same way.
Label precision comes first, then the lift over 100 shuffled diseases. | Neither is measured yet; | scoring waits on that same mapping step.
A blank beats a number we didn't measure.
Every prediction is stored in Tiger Data with its cited chain.
A database trigger refuses any prediction | that arrives without its evidence.
A prediction found in the reports but not on the label | becomes a candidate new signal, shown with its caveats.
Reports keep arriving, so a Creao watch agent | re-counts each watched drug by quarter | and re-checks every signal.
This run used live counts and a hand-picked term: | still above the threshold, at PRR 146.
New at LA Hacks, on Helix's catalog: | the pipeline, both checks, the agents, the watch and the page.
A drug is only a partial knockout, | so its effects may be milder, or absent.
Every genetic disease already ran the *trial*.
